package orgs

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/orgs"
	rules "example.test/auditapp/internal/rules/orgs"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/auditapp/internal/storage/queries/orgs"
)

// TenantStore is the authored organization adapter.
type TenantStore struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewTenantStore(db scope.DB) *TenantStore { return &TenantStore{db: db} }

// ProvisionTx creates the tenant root and its first admin inside the
// provisioning transaction the caller opened for the NEW tenant.
func (s *TenantStore) ProvisionTx(
	ctx context.Context,
	tx scope.Tx,
	in models.Signup,
) (models.Org, error) {
	query := queriesOf(tx)

	row, err := query.CreateOrg(ctx, queries.CreateOrgParams{
		ID:   tx.Tenant(),
		Slug: in.Slug,
		Name: in.Name,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "23505") {
			return models.Org{}, rules.ErrSlugTaken
		}

		return models.Org{}, err
	}

	if err := query.AddMember(ctx, queries.AddMemberParams{
		OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
		ID:    tx.SubjectID(),
		Role:  rules.FirstRole,
	}); err != nil {
		return models.Org{}, err
	}

	return models.Org{
		ID:   tx.Tenant().String(),
		Slug: row.Slug,
		Name: row.Name,
	}, nil
}

func (s *TenantStore) CountMembers(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
) (int64, error) {
	var count int64

	err := s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		var err error

		count, err = queriesOf(tx).CountMembers(ctx, tx.Tenant())

		return err
	})

	return count, err
}
